$comment: Design tokens for fractal-architect renderers. No renderer script may hardcode a color literal — every RGB value used to paint a pixel comes from here, keyed by the render brief's palette_hint. Values are 8-bit sRGB triples.

dark-only, cool boundary / warm interior.description: Julia/escape-time: dark near-black for the bounded set; exterior points interpolate from cool green (fast escape) to warm magenta (slow escape, near boundary).

dark-only, single warm accent on point d.description: IFS chaos-game: dark ground; hit density at each pixel interpolates toward a single warm accent, gamma-compressed so sparse orbit tails stay visible.

dark-only, single warm accent on branch.description: L-system turtle graphics: dark ground; branch color interpolates from a pale trunk tone at depth 0 to a cooler green accent at the outermost tips, evoking new growth without a literal green-on-black cliche.
